summary: Sangoma Technologies filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements, MD&A, and a press release titled 'Sangoma Announces First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results' for the three months ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO and CFO Form 52-109F2 certifications. Results show revenue of $50.06M versus $50.33M, gross profit of $34.97M, and a net loss of $2.89M, with $11.87M cash and $22.15M operating facility and loans. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; a routine quarterly earnings filing with no deal terms to watch.
